name: sq-control-write-readiness-20260701
description: Qualify fan-write implementation by proving donor-style control-expression parity and load-shot pass-rate evidence before implementation starts.

data.label: Gate B0 write-readiness entry lock
data.prompt: Verify that SQ-A-REAL-LOGGING-SHOT-PASSED exists in a tracked SQ-Control status or HIL note before write-readiness qualification starts. Resolve the operator acceptance thresholds before any pass decision: required_pass_rate_pct, required_load_pct, observation_window_minutes, and minimum_shots. If any threshold is missing, vague, or changed after evidence collection starts, block instead of guessing. Agents must not start fan-write implementation, arm writes, change services, or touch legacy-controller state in this readiness flow.

data.agentDefinition: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. Use this for code modifications, file creation/editing, and shell execution.
data.prompt: Gate B1. Build a file-backed control-expression parity matrix before implementation starts. Compare the SQ target contract against donor/reference behavior from SVG-MB runtime evidence and NVG-SmoothControl/SQ existing control code where available. First-round target is the same practical control expressions as the other repos: named mode/profile, active domain, setpoint percent, feedforward percent, correction percent, controller kind, response source, write reason, readback/duty percent, policy block, manual override, and pending-write/journal semantics. Output a tracked SQ-Control artifact with columns: expression or field, SQ target, donor/reference source path, semantic match/delta, allowed difference, implementation owner, and test evidence. Block on prose-only comparison or direct PWM shortcuts that bypass the control pipelines.

data.questionText: B1 control-expression parity matrix is attached. Is it good enough to define load-shot qualification before implementation starts?

options.label: Accept parity
options.description: Proceed to define the load-shot threshold contract from the file-backed parity matrix.

options.label: Manual review
options.description: Pause for operator review without starting implementation.

options.label: Blocked
options.description: Stop and record the missing donor/SQ expression evidence.

data.agentDefinition: Plan-focused agent for designing implementation approaches, work breakdowns, and risk-managed technical plans.
data.prompt: Gate B2. Write the exact load-shot acceptance contract as a tracked SQ-Control artifact before evidence is collected. Required values: required_pass_rate_pct, required_load_pct, observation_window_minutes, minimum_shots, eligible-shot definition, pass/fail formula, accepted load source, accepted time source, artifact paths, and abort conditions. A shot is eligible only when it is inside the observation window, at or above the required load threshold, uses real-only SQ evidence, correlates CSV/status/events/session ids, and contains the control-expression fields from B1. The AI pass recommendation may only be based on this numeric contract, not a subjective summary. Do not start implementation.

data.label: Gate B3 operator load-shot collection
data.prompt: Prepare the operator load-shot runbook. The operator supplies the load window, shot count, duration, and bundle path. Agents do not generate load, arm writes, or start implementation. Required capture: command transcript, binary/config hashes, threshold artifact, parity artifact, status/health/current_state/pending_writes before/during/after, GPU and chassis CSVs, events JSONL, manifests, session ids, load source, time window, and every eligible shot boundary. If the run needs live writes, stop and require a separate operator HIL runbook.

data.description: Gate B4 AI load-shot evidence evaluation
data.agentDefinition: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. Use this for code modifications, file creation/editing, and shell execution.
data.prompt: Gate B4. Inspect the operator load-shot bundle read-only and compute the acceptance result from files. Parse the threshold contract, parity artifact, CSV/status/events/manifests, and load source. Count total shots, eligible shots, passing shots, failing shots, excluded shots, required_pass_rate_pct, actual_pass_rate_pct, required_load_pct, observed load range, observation_window_minutes, and actual time window. Pass recommendation is allowed only when actual_pass_rate_pct is at or above required_pass_rate_pct, the observation window satisfies the configured timeframe, the load threshold is met, the minimum shot count is met, and all B1 control-expression fields are present with accepted deltas. Block on missing thresholds, stale bundles, sim/fake data, prose-only evidence, unmatched sessions, or unresolved pending writes. Write a tracked SQ-Control evaluation artifact with the exact pass/block recommendation. Do not write SQ-B-WRITE-READINESS-PASSED automatically.

data.questionText: B4 computed the load-shot pass rate over the configured timeframe. Accept SQ-B-WRITE-READINESS-PASSED and allow fan-write implementation to start?

options.label: Readiness passed
options.description: Evidence meets the configured percentage, load, timeframe, and expression-parity contract; implementation may start.

options.label: Manual review
options.description: Pause before implementation while keeping the evidence bundle intact.

options.label: Blocked
options.description: Stop before implementation and record the failing threshold or missing evidence.
